+++ b/events.py
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+MAX_RECENT = 64
+
+
+def accept_event(recent: dict, event: dict):
+    event_id = event['id']
+    stored = dict(event)
+    recent[event_id] = stored
+    while len(recent) > MAX_RECENT:
+        del recent[next(iter(recent))]
+    return stored, True
